d:
Hello everyone,

I am no artist whatsoever and don't plan to ever earn money with my comics. I use NovelAI to generate the images and do it for fun. I just want to share the stuff I come up with. If you have suggestions for other stories, feel free to send me your ideas. I am mostly into gender bender, sissyfication and transformation stories, so please do not bother to ask me for anything else. As I said there is not going to be a fansly, patreon or any other form of payment for my stories. I just do it as a hobby.

You can tip me here if you want, but there is no need to :) : https://fansly.com/Horadriel/media/wall/840698615105081344

Have fun and do not bother me
